_comment: Shipping zones for the shop. Edit the amounts here, then run:
AMOUNTS ARE PLACEHOLDERS and must be confirmed against what Prodigi
actually charges for dispatch. They were NOT taken from the Etsy PDFs —
those export delivery profile names but no figures.
Zones are matched top to bottom; the first zone containing the customer's
country wins, so keep the catch-all ('*') last.
taxBehavior: 'exclusive' adds tax on top, 'inclusive' means the amount
already contains it, 'unspecified' only works with automatic tax off.
